g.text: Query column on the left, the live placement map on
the right two-thirds. The top edge is the field: no box,
and no provider pill row, only a tracked label and
prefix characters (w: windows, a: apps, = calc, ~ files).
Windows results are drawn in their real rects (3px
radius, 1px outline sampled from the rail by x). Typing
colours them on the state axis by match score: top
purple, strong blue; non-matches drop to a 25% outline
and stay, so the map keeps its shape. The selected rect
has a white edge. The 2px blue selection line is the
Apps provider: the dashed rect is the engine's answer
for where the launch will land (tiling splits the
focused leaf). Ctrl+Enter launches into the selected
The launcher dismisses on opacity only. The chosen
rect grows into the real window (280ms), holds a
400ms white outline, releases. Focus follows and the

svg.text: Phosphor · launcher · viewfinder over the placement map · Windows provider main, Apps inset · 8s loop
